title: The fork harness is not hermetic: globalSetup falls back to ALCHEMY_URL, the spawned Hardhat child inherits the parent environment and its config loads the real .env, plain `npm test` runs the fork project too, and the fork replays take risk caps, the stop-loss and alert credentials from the operator's .env and call live third-party safety APIs, so a fork result depends on the machine it ran on

evidence.note: rpcUrl = process.env.ETH_FORK_RPC_URL || process.env.ALCHEMY_URL (the fallback CONTEXT says to drop)
execSync("npx hardhat compile") and spawn("npx", ["hardhat", "node", "--fork", rpcUrl, ...], { shell: true }) with no env option: the child inherits the full parent environment
dotenv.config() at config load: the Hardhat child reads the real .env (CONTRACTS slice owns this file)

the hardhat network forks from ETH_FORK_RPC_URL || ALCHEMY_URL with no accounts override (default Hardhat accounts); the DEPLOY_PRIVATE_KEY networks at :51-95 are only used with --network, which setup.ts never passes
dotenv config() for every project, the fork project included
the fork project includes test/fork/**/*.test.ts with globalSetup test/fork/setup.ts
"test": "vitest run --reporter=verbose" names no project, so npm test also runs the fork globalSetup (spawns Hardhat against the configured fork RPC)
comment: the risk env is set "so canSnipe ... passes ... the operator's live .env caps would otherwise block at the risk gate"
only some exit and risk keys are overridden; every other key (Telegram, safety-API config, STOP_LOSS_PCT here) comes from the real .env
isLiquidityLockedForChain (run by the real handlers the replays drive) calls the live Unicrypt API; honeypotIs.ts:16 and goplus.ts:33 likewise

sibling_sites_checked: All 23 test/fork files and the three config files at the base SHA. Every provider in the fork suite targets 127.0.0.1:8545 (grep JsonRpcProvider/WebSocketProvider over test/fork); the only process spawned is the Hardhat child in setup.ts (D-03 documented exemption). hardhat_reset calls (captureRehearsal:335, deliberateBuyReplay:259, exitStatePersistence:424, realLaunchReplay:258, honeypotChecker:272, antiRugDetector:785) send the fork RPC URL to the local node only.
severity_rationale: S3: no signing or capital path (see the trace); the harness is non-hermetic, so a green or red fork run reflects the operator's .env and the live state of third-party APIs as much as the code. The real-.env exposure itself is the RC-19 rediscovery AUD-TESTI-011.
recommendation: Phase 25 (fork harness, first fork execution): drop the ALCHEMY_URL fallback (CONTEXT Claude's-discretion item), spawn Hardhat with an explicit minimal env (fork URL only) and make hardhat.config.ts skip dotenv under the fork harness, scope `npm test` to unit + integration (AC-12), and give every fork replay an explicit, complete env and stubbed third-party safety APIs.

traces.scenario: Could a fork run sign with the operator's real key against real mainnet (PROTOCOL rail judgment)?
steps: Every fork test builds its provider on http://127.0.0.1:8545 (the node setup.ts spawned) and signs with Hardhat account #0 or #1 (realMainnetGate.ts:125-126, honeypotChecker.fork.test.ts:41-42, honeypotMultiAmount.fork.test.ts:54-55, snipeLifecycle.test.ts:12, antiRugDetector.fork.test.ts:208-209).

The fork tests that import src (captureRehearsal, deliberateBuyReplay, exitStatePersistence, realLaunchReplay) pass a hand-built ctx with that provider and wallet; they never call startMultiChainBot, createChainContext or getWallet, the only src sites that build a Wallet from PRIVATE_KEY (src/bot.ts:1705-1706, src/chainRegistry.ts:1067, src/utils/provider.ts:59).

The Hardhat child runs "hardhat node" on the hardhat network (default accounts, chainId 31337); the mainnet network entry that reads DEPLOY_PRIVATE_KEY (hardhat.config.ts:60-68) is used only with --network mainnet, which setup.ts never passes.
If port 8545 were already taken, the Hardhat child fails to bind and setup.ts:29-35 rejects on the stderr error, so no test reaches an unknown node.
traces.outcome: No: no path signs with the real key or sends to real mainnet. The real .env is read (exposure, AUD-TESTI-011) but not used for signing, so this is not a rail-class reach (D-16) and the run is not stopped.
